{{Top|leg}}
The '''Catacomb of Eminents''' was a sacred site on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Sullust/Legends|Sullust]] where the [[Funeral/Legends|funeral]] of [[Galactic Federation of Free Alliances|Galactic Alliance]] [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Sien Sovv]] was held in [[36 ABY]]. The catacomb held the vaults of eminent [[Sullustan/Legends|Sullustans]], and spilled out into the [[Gallery of Ancestors]].
